map_reuse_strategy.contract: A new Work Map may only be proposed after documented rejection of reuse, extension, cross-map composition, and generator/taxonomy extension against the closest existing maps. The proposal cannot authorize implementation in the same Spec Kit.

new_spec_kit_contract: Every new Spec Kit must contain a current work-map-integration.json generated from all repository Work Maps and the effective schema classification registry.
implementation_contract: When a PR changes implementation or repository-governance surfaces, all targeted Work Map, schema-domain, taxonomy-gap, and discovered-dimension decisions must be resolved and implementation_readiness.status must be ready.
classification_contract: No schema object may remain unclassified by accident. Every generated taxonomy gap must be mapped to existing Work Maps or recorded as an intentional, owned, expiring exception.
legacy_behavior: Existing Spec Kits without a work-map-integration.json remain grandfathered until they opt in. New Spec Kits are never grandfathered.
